title: Sheu Tweaks
description: Client side. Performance pack which adds mods to make the game cleaner, more immersive, and more satisfying, while keeping the essence of vanilla Minecraft.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bk7XLcjy/images/82704fa44baec3ddafa22b5fb37bbe8fb6271095.png)

---

Opinionated client-side modpack that enhances most aspects of the vanilla experience through small improvements to visuals, audio, and performance. 

Here's a tiny preview of the sounds part of the mod:

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6WqECQ0Uohg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

I wanted a vanilla feeling but adding some bits that make the game better in my opinion. I spent way too long putting together a modpack for me and my friends that adds/fixes all those small things i craved while keeping the core gameplay the same. All while keeping FPS high :)  

With Voxy, you get ultra high render distance using LODs:

![How using the modpack looks from above](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c5ae68ae9b039e344e9c1f616b6e62bb170cc6c.jpeg)

![Beautiful sunrise with the modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8528b4870c6e5bccbf50b6eb41c3a194e825998e.jpeg)

![Sunrise with the modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06ec4b5940ac35d6e5921306a6f5326b02b52790.webp)

It's client-side, which means **you can join any vanilla server** without problems. 

**WARNING: Some servers anti-cheat might flag the Mouse Wheelie mod. Beware**

---

Main mods:

- Better performance: Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, Noisium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore
  
- Visual tweaks: 3D Skin Layers, WaveyCapes, LambDynamicLights, Continuity, Visuality, Better Clouds, Particle Rain, Camera Overhaul, and way more
  
- Sounds: AmbientSounds, Sound Physics Remastered, Presence Footsteps Lite, Drip Sounds
  
- QOL: BetterF3, Ok Zoomer, Shulker Box Tooltip, AppleSkin, Mouse Wheelie, Chat Heads, Xaero's World Map, Better Hurt Cam, BetterF1

##  Mods You Might Want to Disable

- ValveSprint - if you like the vanilla movement 

- Voxy - if you want to play with some specific shaders (shader support for Voxy is limited right now, but it works with some (see [supported list](https://gist.github.com/appleneko2001/51dcf842c934db4c6201146f2e594953)). I recommend [photon](https://github.com/sixthsurge/photon/tree/voxy-support))

- Xaero's World Map - if you prefer playing without a map

- Simple Voice Chat - if you don't need voice chat functionality

- Sound Physics Remastered - if the reverb/echo effects feel too intense for you
